scope: Saved Scene2D visual animation preview; source only

reviews.area: Frozen animation envelope and optional HTTP attachment
checks: Same captured source/plan/snapshot; no second World read or full build
Exact scene/manifest revision and stable instance membership; descriptor-safe copy
Old static, draft and composition response shapes retained

reviews.area: Visual sample and Canvas, independent review against Godot visual container
reviews.finding: Actor instanceId originally read directly, accepting getter and inherited values. Trusted HTTP JSON did not carry them, but pure capture boundary was inconsistent.
reviews.fix: Dense own-data actor identity capture, no custom map or getter execution
checks: Root+offset then degree rotation then scale agrees with existing visual container
Nonzero image RGBA tint alpha multiplied by animation alpha
Labels stay logical and alpha 1; duplicate-definition instances remain separate
Full frame replacement prevents prior-channel leakage; no layout commit
Hide, model replacement, edit entry, destroy clear overlay; stop preserves view/cache

reviews.area: UI and lifecycle independent source audit
checks: Refresh clears animation before any async work; saved refresh clears old model, failed draft may retain static only
Capability revocation clears player and prevents late envelope installation; re-enable uses new epoch
Draft/composition gate uses selected-document context independently of model reset
Epoch/signal/scene/visible/available checks release superseded image leases
No per-frame translation or repeated status text mutations

nonClaims: No new Godot or Bevy run
No installed app or Android/device verification
No author edits, physics, behavior or audio playback by preview
